auth.registerBody: Use your mobile number to sign in on any device.
auth.resetBody: Enter the recovery code you saved when you created your account.
auth.adultConfirm: I confirm I am 18 or older.
auth.noRecoveryCode: Lost your recovery code? Contact support to recover your account.
auth.offlineBody: Connect to the internet to sign in. Matches saved on this device are safe.

recovery.title: Save your recovery code
recovery.body: This code is the only way to reset your password. Store it somewhere safe. It won't be shown again.
recovery.confirm: I've saved my recovery code somewhere safe.
recovery.fileContents:
ScoreSphere recovery code: {{code}}
Keep this private. You need it to reset your password.

profile.title: Profile
profile.discoverable: Let people find me by phone number
profile.discoverableBody: When on, team admins who enter your number see your name and photo. When off, they can only send you an invitation.
profile.changePasswordBody: You'll stay signed in here; other devices are signed out.
profile.changePhoneBody: Your current number is {{phone}}. Your teams and history move with you.
profile.newRecoveryCodeBody: Your old recovery code will stop working.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.personalBody: Your personal workspace is just for you. Create an organization to score with others.
workspaces.newOrganizationBody: For a school, college, club, academy or group that scores together.
workspaces.name: Name
workspaces.leaveConfirm: Leave this workspace? You'll need a new invitation to rejoin.
workspaces.inviteBody: Create a link and share it on WhatsApp or anywhere else. Each link works once and expires in 7 days.
workspaces.linkReady: Share this link with one person:
workspaces.inviteMessage: Join my team on ScoreSphere as {{role}}:
workspaces.notFound: This workspace doesn't exist or you no longer have access.

join.title: Join {{workspace}}
join.alreadyMember: You're already a member of this workspace.
join.invalidBody: This invitation link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.ADULT_REQUIRED: You must be 18 or older to create an account.

errors.INVALID_RECOVERY_CODE: Mobile number or recovery code is incorrect.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.

common.comingSoonBody: This part of ScoreSphere is being built.

teams.title: Teams
teams.name: Team name
teams.empty: No teams yet. Create one to start building your line-ups.
teams.notFoundTeam: This team doesn't exist or was archived.
teams.addPlayersBody: Add someone by phone to link their profile, or just by name.
teams.phonePrivacy: Only people who allow it are shown. Everyone else gets an invitation.
teams.notFound: Not found, or their profile is private. Add them with a name and invite them to join.
teams.nameOnlyBody: For players without a phone, like students. Only your workspace sees them, and you can link a number later.
teams.rosterAllAdded: Everyone on your roster is already in this team.
teams.archiveConfirm: Archive {{name}}? Past matches keep their line-ups.

roster.title: Roster
roster.body: Everyone this workspace scores for. Teams pick players from here.
roster.empty: No one on the roster yet.
roster.claimBody: The account “{{account}}” says it is {{name}}. Approve only if you know this is the same person.
roster.adminWillReview: An admin will review this claim.
roster.archiveConfirm: Archive {{name}}? They'll be removed from all teams.
roster.invitedHint: {{name}} will see this team after signing up with that number.
roster.inviteMessage: Hi {{name}}, {{workspace}} added you on ScoreSphere. Sign up with this number to see your matches and stats: {{link}}
roster.addPhoneBody: They'll be linked if their profile is public; otherwise they get an invitation when they sign up with this number.

rosterLinks.title: Teams that added you
rosterLinks.body: Confirm the ones that are really you, so your matches and stats follow your account.

guests.body: For one-off games. Guests stay on this phone only; promote them to the roster to keep their stats.
